saw_lines: Buyers of powered outdoor gear compare it with knee braces, then hesitate to prepay for a device they cannot try on.
So the sale is decided on the reserve step, where buyers need proof the device works before they pay.
Your 7 Google creatives, first shown 2025-10-03, include just 1 video, so build three new videos that open on your $80 price and a site customer quote.
ads_1: Video led Google creative built around the $80 price and customer quotes
